description: This line plot illustrates the performance of two models, “Ours” and “ReFICR,” across varying search depths, specifically measuring Recall@50 and NDCG@50. The x-axis represents the search depth, ranging from 1 to 5, with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis on the left, labeled “Recall@50,” uses a linear scale from 0.30 to 0.60, while the y-axis on the right, labeled “NDCG@50,” uses a linear scale from 0.15 to 0.22. The plot displays four lines: “Recall@50 (Ours)” is shown as a solid green line with circle markers, starting at approximately 0.35 at depth 1 and rising to about 0.49 at depth 5; “Recall@50 (ReFICR)” is a dashed green line with circle markers, remaining constant at approximately 0.47 across all depths; “NDCG@50 (Ours)” is a solid blue line with square markers, beginning at about 0.32 and increasing to roughly 0.46; and “NDCG@50 (ReFICR)” is a dashed blue line with square markers, staying flat at approximately 0.16 throughout the search depth range.
